description: Calculate core risk metrics for a portfolio — Value at Risk (VaR), Conditional VaR (CVaR), volatility, beta, and max drawdown.

benchmark.description: Benchmark ticker for beta calculation, e.g. SPY or QQQ. Default: SPY.

confidence_level.description: VaR confidence level as a decimal, e.g. 0.95 = 95%. Range: 0.01-0.99. Default: 0.95.

horizon_days.description: Risk horizon in trading days. 1 = overnight, 21 ≈ 1 month, 252 ≈ 1 year. Default: 1.

lookback_days.description: Number of historical trading days to use. 252 ≈ 1 year, 756 ≈ 3 years. Range: 30-1260. Default: 252.

method.description: VaR calculation method. "historical" uses empirical return distribution, "parametric" assumes normality, "cornish_fisher" adjusts for skew and kurtosis. Default: "historical".

positions.description: Array of portfolio positions. Each entry needs a ticker and quantity. Free tier: max 20 positions. Paid tier: up to 500.

cost_basis.description: Per-share cost basis in USD. Optional — used only for P&L calculations.

quantity.description: Number of shares held. Use a negative value to represent a short position.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL or MSFT. Must be uppercase, 1-10 characters.

name: analyze_risk
